source_arithmetic_domain.canonical_text:
theorem source_arithmetic_domain
    (d T : ℕ) (X V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (hVX : V ⊆ X) (hVclosed : IsClosed V) (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EReal)
    (hbot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hu : u ∈ X)
    (hx : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ V)
    (hmin : ∀ t ≤ T, IsMinOn (objective psi loss t) V (x t)) :
    (sourceRHS T V psi loss x u).isSome ↔
      (∀ t ≤ T, objective psi loss t (x t) ≠ ⊤) ∧
      ¬ (playedTop T loss x ∧ comparatorTop T loss u)

lawful_source_identity.canonical_text:
theorem lawful_source_identity
    (d T : ℕ) (X V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (hVX : V ⊆ X) (hVclosed : IsClosed V) (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EReal)
    (hbot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hu : u ∈ X)
    (hx : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ V)
    (hmin : ∀ t ≤ T, IsMinOn (objective psi loss t) V (x t))
    (hselected : ∀ t ≤ T, objective psi loss t (x t) ≠ ⊤)
    (hexclusive : ¬ (playedTop T loss x ∧ comparatorTop T loss u)) :
    sourceLHS T loss x u = sourceRHS T V psi loss x u ∧
      (sourceLHS T loss x u).isSome

played_top_source_identity.canonical_text:
theorem played_top_source_identity
    (d T : ℕ) (X V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (hVX : V ⊆ X) (hVclosed : IsClosed V) (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EReal)
    (hbot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hu : u ∈ X)
    (hx : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ V)
    (hmin : ∀ t ≤ T, IsMinOn (objective psi loss t) V (x t))
    (hselected : ∀ t ≤ T, objective psi loss t (x t) ≠ ⊤)
    (hplayed : playedTop T loss x)
    (hcomparator : ¬ comparatorTop T loss u) :
    sourceLHS T loss x u = some ⊤ ∧ sourceRHS T V psi loss x u = some ⊤

comparator_top_source_identity.canonical_text:
theorem comparator_top_source_identity
    (d T : ℕ) (X V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (hVX : V ⊆ X) (hVclosed : IsClosed V) (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EReal)
    (hbot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hu : u ∈ X)
    (hx : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ V)
    (hmin : ∀ t ≤ T, IsMinOn (objective psi loss t) V (x t))
    (hselected : ∀ t ≤ T, objective psi loss t (x t) ≠ ⊤)
    (hplayed : ¬ playedTop T loss x)
    (hcomparator : comparatorTop T loss u) :
    sourceLHS T loss x u = some ⊥ ∧ sourceRHS T V psi loss x u = some ⊥

theorem both_top_source_undefined
    (d T : ℕ) (X V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)))
    (hVX : V ⊆ X) (hVclosed : IsClosed V) (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EReal)
    (hbot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (hu : u ∈ X)
    (hx : ∀ t ≤ T, x t ∈ V)
    (hmin : ∀ t ≤ T, IsMinOn (objective psi loss t) V (x t))
    (hselected : ∀ t ≤ T, objective psi loss t (x t) ≠ ⊤)
    (hplayed : playedTop T loss x)
    (hcomparator : comparatorTop T loss u) :

sourceAdd.canonical_text:
def sourceAdd (a b : EReal) : Option EReal :=
  if (a = ⊤ ∧ b = ⊥) ∨ (a = ⊥ ∧ b = ⊤) then none else some (a + b)

sourceSub.canonical_text: def sourceSub (a b : EReal) : Option EReal := sourceAdd a (-b)

sourceSum.canonical_text:
def sourceSum : ℕ → (ℕ → Option EReal) → Option EReal
  | 0, _ => some 0
  | n + 1, f => (sourceSum n f).bind (fun a => (f n).bind (sourceAdd a))

sourceRHS.canonical_text:
def sourceRHS {E : Type*} (T : ℕ) (V : Set E) (psi : ℕ → E → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x : ℕ → E) (u : E) : Option EReal :=
  let F := objective psi loss
  let brackets := sourceSum T (fun t =>
    (sourceSub (F t (x t)) (F (t + 1) (x (t + 1)))).bind
      (fun delta => sourceAdd delta (loss t (x t))))
  -- Preserve the displayed outer left association: initial + sum + a_T - F_T(u).
  brackets.bind (fun s =>
    (sourceAdd ((psi T u - sInf (psi 0 '' V) : ℝ) : EReal) s).bind
      (fun q => (sourceAdd q (F T (x T))).bind
        (fun r => sourceSub r (F T u))))

playedTop.canonical_text:
def playedTop {E : Type*} (T : ℕ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x : ℕ → E) : Prop :=
  ∃ t < T, loss t (x t) = ⊤

comparatorTop.canonical_text:
def comparatorTop {E : Type*} (T : ℕ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (u : E) : Prop :=
  ∃ t < T, loss t u = ⊤

source_model: Let V ⊆ X ⊆ ℝᵈ, with V closed and nonempty, and let T be any natural number. Regularizers are real-valued on X. For every i < T, losses take values in ℝ ∪ {+∞}, never −∞, on the ambient space. Supply feasible order minimizers xₙ of Fₙ over V for 0 ≤ n ≤ T. The comparator u lies in X and need not lie in V. Lean uses an ambient real-valued extension agreeing with the source regularizer on X. The actual Function.extend restriction and source-subtype backtransport certificate recover the X-domain formulation without changing values on X.
indexing: Use zero-based Fₙ(v) = ψₙ(v) + ∑ᵢ₌₀ⁿ⁻¹ ℓᵢ(v), with an empty sum at n = 0. Lean n corresponds to printed n+1, so ψ_T and x_T represent printed ψ_(T+1) and x_(T+1). Let aₙ = Fₙ(xₙ), P mean some played loss ℓᵢ(xᵢ) is +∞, and C mean some comparator loss ℓᵢ(u) is +∞.
partial_semantics: Evaluate the printed arithmetic as partial extended-real arithmetic: opposing infinities cannot be added, equal infinities cannot be subtracted, and an undefined subexpression makes its ordered enclosing expression undefined. A defined result may be finite, +∞ or −∞. Lean some z records that defined value; none records undefined arithmetic, not a numerical value.
mathematical_boundary: This package concerns the arithmetic domain of a supplied minimizing run. It does not construct a run, justify algorithm-specific terminal-term deletion, or finish targets 133/168, the algorithm-specific targets 86/87, Chapter 2 or the book. Selected-top examples are obstructions for the order-minimizer interface; attributing them to the printed algorithm depends on its argmin convention. The finite-selected same-index both-top example is independent of that convention.
